description: Source code for SPDY HTTP utilities, including functions for converting headers between SPDY and HTTP, creating SPDY headers from HTTP requests, and handling request priorities.

methods.name: AddSpdyHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to SPDY headers, concatenating with existing values if necessary.

methods.name: SpdyHeadersToHttpResponse
methods.description: Converts SPDY headers to an HTTP response object.

methods.name: CreateSpdyHeadersFromHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates SPDY headers from an HTTP request.

methods.name: CreateSpdyHeadersFromHttpRequestForWebSocket
methods.description: Creates SPDY headers for WebSocket handshake from an HTTP request.

methods.name: ConvertRequestPriorityToSpdyPriority
methods.description: Converts a request priority to a SPDY priority.

methods.name: ConvertSpdyPriorityToRequestPriority
methods.description: Converts a SPDY priority to a request priority.

methods.name: ConvertHeaderBlockToHttpRequestHeaders
methods.description: Converts SPDY header block to HTTP request headers.
